va-fx-commercial-gfa.title: Special exception: data center building over 40,000 sq ft in C-3 or C-4
va-fx-commercial-gfa.process: after a Planning Commission public hearing; the county estimates about six months from official acceptance
va-fx-commercial-gfa.description: The 40,000 sq ft limit applies to gross floor area per building.

checks.claim: C-3 and C-4 maximum building size is 40,000 sq ft of gross floor area; larger needs special exception
checks.result: confirmed; the fixture previously pointed to page 3, the clause is on PDF page 2

checks.claim: The Board of Supervisors approves or denies special exceptions after a Planning Commission hearing
checks.result: confirmed: Planning Commission hearing, then Board public hearing is the final decision

checks.claim: About six months from official acceptance
checks.result: confirmed: "approximately 6 months from the official date of acceptance"; this is an estimate, not a deadline

va-fx-commercial-gfa.effective_basis: County data centers page: adopted September 10, 2024; effective September 11, 2024.
va-fx-commercial-gfa.applies_to: Applications and plans filed after the effective date. The 2026 amendment (ZO 112.2-2026-22, adopted October 27, 2026; its text states no effective date) adds rezoning and special exception submission items for facilities of 100 MW or more; do not apply it to earlier approvals.
